summary: Station Road kerb where cars park, with apartments 10-20 m away.
reasons: Cars park along the southern half

best_section.where: Station Road east kerb, south of the large apartment block, among parked cars

drivers.seclusion: Apartments and houses 10-20 m from the kerb on its own side; homes all round.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerbside lane with several cars parked in 2022 imagery; room for a van among them.
drivers.traffic: Busy through road, but the kerb is outside the through lanes.
drivers.convention: Cars park here, though signs restrict stopping 4-6pm and 3-7pm Mon-Sat.

flags: Dwellings 9-12 m at both ends of the stretch
sun_shade: Street trees and buildings on the east side shade the kerb in the afternoon.
cannot_judge: How full the kerb is overnight, as Esri shows fewer cars than QLD
